svg.title: Event block 104 – 131 – change counter, last time stamp and 8-entry ring (newest first) – drawing 53-07
svg.text: Event block 104 – 131 – change counter, last time stamp and 8-entry ring (newest first)
Example captured on HMC-01 of the virtual plant + reconstruction by the controller (Δ = counter − last counter) · thesis ch. 5.4, Table 5.2
On every state change (one scan of the PLC):
2 tLast := PLC time in ms (UINT32, wraps after 49.7 days)
3 entries 6 … 0 move to 7 … 1 (oldest entry 7 is dropped)
5 all in the SAME scan → the client never reads a half update*
* a Modbus read is served between scans (Siemens MB_SERVER: in the call; Delta: comm. task) – check the PLC manual.
P_loss = Pr{ N(λ·T) > R }, N ~ Poisson
λ = state changes per second of the device
T = longest gap between two EVENT polls
Lab result (thesis Table 5.3): 15 runs, up to 160 devices, 23 825 true state changes → 0 lost with the event block;
state-only polling of the same data missed 29 – 37 % at P = 1 s, 9 – 11 % at 0.25 s and 2 % at 0.1 s.
